'''Rangthang''', also known as '''Rang Thang''', was a four-armed DJ who worked for the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was present when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] came looking for [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro the Hutt]].<ref name="Hunt for Ziro" />

==Behind the scenes==
According to concept art found in the old episode guide for "Hunt for Ziro", Rang Thang's species also has four legs, eight [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] total.<ref name="Concept">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode309.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hunt for Ziro|date=2010-11-12}} {{C|Concept Art, slide 10}}</ref>
